name: Val Hoyle
stance: Calls for Congress to stay in session to enact AI guardrails rather than letting tech companies set the rules; original cosponsor of the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act.

statements.text: Experts are sounding the alarm bells about the rapid speed of AI development, while Congress is quiet. I joined my colleagues in demanding Speaker Johnson keep us in D.C. so we can put clear guardrails in place.
We cannot sit on our hands, punt this work into the future and let big tech corporations dictate the rules.
Original cosponsor of the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538).
